items.title: Mo State Takes on No. 21 Liberty in Senior Day Finale
items.summary: Missouri State closes out the regular season Saturday afternoon when the Bears host nationally-ranked Liberty at 1 p.m. on Senior Day. The Bears are 4-1 at Plaster Stadium this season and 12-5 in their last 17 at home.

items.title: Football Bears Fall to Jax State, 25-20, in Wild Road Finale
items.summary: JACKSONVILLE, Ala. – Jacksonville State reeled off 22 unanswered points in the fourth quarter to erase a 17-point deficit and slip past visiting Missouri State, 25-20, here Saturday in Conference USA play.

items.title: Mo State Heads to Jax State for CUSA Road Matchup
items.summary: Missouri State takes to the road Saturday for a 1 p.m. kickoff at Jacksonville State. The Bears (3-3) have won 2 of their last 3 in Conference USA and are in a five-way tie for third place with two games to play. Mo State trails only Jax State (5-1) and first-place Liberty (6-0) in the league standings.

items.title: Boamah Named CUSA Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: Missouri State cornerback Joel Boamah (Sr., Newark, N.J.) has been named as Conference USA Defensive Player of the Week, the league announced Monday afternoon.

items.title: Bears Walk Off Aggies in Thrilling Homecoming Win
items.summary: An 88-yard interception return by Joel Boamah in overtime secured a remarkable comeback win for Missouri State here Saturday as the Bears rallied for a 27-21 homecoming victory over visiting New Mexico State.

items.title: Football Hosts NM State in Homecoming Clash at Plaster
items.summary: Missouri State returns to Robert W. Plaster Stadium this Saturday (Nov. 14) when the Bears entertain New Mexico State on Homecoming (2 p.m. kickoff). The Conference USA matchup will highlight a busy weekend in Springfield where the Bears have won 5 straight homecoming contests.

items.title: Wild Fourth-Quarter Finish Goes FIU’s Way in Miami
items.summary: A 35-yard field goal by FIU kicker Robert Czeremcha as time expired lifted home-standing FIU past Missouri State here Saturday, 23-20, capping off a wild series of plays over the final seven minutes of the Conference USA thriller.

items.title: O'Neal Named as Burlsworth Trophy Nominee
items.summary: Missouri State safety J.J. O'Neal (5th Yr., Rogersville, Mo.) was announced this week as one of 65 nominees for the 2026 Burlsworth Trophy, recognizing outstanding college football players from across the country who began their careers as walk-ons and have distinguished themselves through their performance, determination and perseverance.

items.title: Football Bears Begin November Stretch with Trip to FIU
items.summary: Missouri State begins a four-game November stretch this Saturday (Nov. 7) when the Bears make their first-ever trip to Pittbull Stadium in Miami to take on the  FIU Panthers at 3 p.m. (Central) on ESPN+.

items.title: McDonald Named to Ray Guy Award List for Week 9
items.summary: Missouri State punter Stewart McDonald (Jr., Rogersville, Mo.) was named to the Ray Guy Award "Ray's 8" for week nine of the college football schedule, the organization announced Monday (Nov. 2).
